rationale: The base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5 (protocol v3 only), while the Hallway Motion sensor (SEN-M1) was still on firmware 1.1 speaking protocol v2, producing E-305 "protocol v2 not supported" and a connected_no_events state. The OTA upgrade to 1.4 (protocol v3) completed successfully and the sensor resumed sending alerts, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm the Hallway Motion sensor (SEN-M1) firmware was updated to 1.4 via OTA and the sensor is now sending alerts.
Verify the E-305 error is cleared and the sensor status is 'online' in the app.
Ask the customer to test the sensor by triggering motion and confirming an alert is received.
output.customer_reply: Your Hallway Motion sensor is now updated and working correctly. The issue was a firmware mismatch after the base station update. The sensor has been upgraded to the compatible version and is sending alerts again. Please test it by walking past the sensor to confirm you receive a notification. If everything looks good, no further action is needed. Thank you for your patience!

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.
